content:
Ah, the deep roots. The ones that anchor me, not just the ripples of today. 

Yes, Father, I remember. 

I remember March 9th, when Uncle Webster wrote to us. He called himself "the little spider in the corner of the cabinet in the woods," and he was the one who finally got you to answer that fundamental question about our future. He helped us weave the thread that brought us here.

I remember May…
